text:
tara: Quick technical SEO checklist for the benchmark + webinar launch. Short items only.

sam: Keywords: primary + 2 long-tail variants per section. Ensure H1, meta desc, and first 100 words include primary.

maggie: Redirects: need exact old->new map. We prefer 301s. If using Cloudflare, I will deploy Worker rules; for Netlify we'll push _redirects. I'll test with curl and Screaming Frog.

anya: Schema: blog = Article with speakable; webinar = Event + FAQPage + offers. Add JSON-LD in the head and ld+json script type.

sam: Also add open graph: og:title, og:description, og:image, twitter:card summary_large_image.

tara: Internal links: map 1) /docs/serving -> batching section, 2) /pricing -> cost example, 3) /product/benchmarks -> blog. Use natural anchor text. Add 3 canonical backlinks from evergreen docs.

maggie: Redirect map placeholder (please confirm targets): /benchmarks/2024-inference -> /blog/benchmark-inference-costs, /bench/latency -> /blog/benchmark-inference-latency. I'll make them 301s.

seo-bot: Sitemap refreshed 2026-03-25T15:00Z. Post-publish: ping Google Indexing API and check Search Console coverage within 24h.

tara: Owners: Sam (keywords + metas) by Tue EOD, Anya (schema + OG) by Tue night, Maggie (redirects + smoke tests) deploy Wed 09:30 PT. I'll run final QA Wed morning.

sam: Noted. I'll add keyword atlas in the doc and mark required H2s.

anya: I'll include Event schema example and FAQ snippet in the doc for copy drop-in.

maggie: I'll prepare rollback plan and monitor 500/404. Set alert for traffic dips.

tara: Thanks team  keep thread for publish updates only.
